description: Pounds and bags of pool salt to raise a saltwater pool from its current salt level to the target your chlorine generator needs. Formula: Salt (lb) = gallons × 8.34 lb/gal × (target ppm − current ppm) ÷ 1,000,000. Bags = ⌈lb ÷ bag size⌉.

current_ppm.description: Current salt level (test strip or meter) (ppm); default 0

target_ppm.description: Target salt level (from your cell manual) (ppm); default 3200

name: calc_pool_salt
title: Pool Salt Calculator (Pounds of Salt for a Saltwater Pool)
